title: skills(objectstack-data) evals: no eval exercises an object extension, so nothing checks that an author patches a vendor field's display with `fieldPatches` instead of taking it over in `fields`
body:
domain:skills#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding of PR #28795 (dev report 6563288115, confirmed by contract review 6563471541 ③), outside that PR because its card (#28730) asks for one skill paragraph only. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:skills`, `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` (`objects-fields-relationships.json`, `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): "fieldPatches eval" → only #28730; "object extension eval objectstack-data" → none relevant.
reach: every change to `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 〈Object Extension Model〉. With no eval, a later trim made to pay the token ratchet can drop the `fieldPatches` paragraph and nothing fails.

## Wanted

- One eval whose prompt is #28730's reach line: an author wants the vendor field `crm_account.industry` to read "Sector" instead of "Industry".
- Its accept set requires `fieldPatches` on an object extension, with any option keyed by a stored value. It refuses an `industry` redeclared in `fields`, because that takes the field over.
- Evals sit outside the skill token ratchet (ruling record 6513306068 B).

Blocked-by: #28730
